verdict.rationale: Payment lifecycle webhooks are a fair question for a POS product that processes payments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks for authorized, captured, refunded or disputed payment events. The GraphQL Admin API access from POS UI extensions and the Shopify Flow low-stock notifications are only adjacent building blocks, not payment-event webhooks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payment lifecycle events (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations
